# T1 evals — shared UI primitives (BentoGrid, Tile, SoonTile, RetryTile, MissingTile, SoonButton, Meter, BarList, AskCard, CountUp, Reveal) + dev gallery

Import path for all tests: `@/components/ui/<Name>` (named export `<Name>`); tests live in `tests/components/ui-*.test.tsx`. Run: `npx vitest run tests/components/<file>`.

E1. Files + exports — proves every primitive exists and is a named export — cmd: `for n in BentoGrid Tile SoonTile RetryTile MissingTile SoonButton Meter BarList AskCard CountUp Reveal; do test -f src/components/ui/$n.tsx && grep -qE "export (function|const) $n\b|export \{[^}]*\b$n\b" src/components/ui/$n.tsx || echo MISSING $n; done` — PASS if no output, exit 0.

E2. Tile element type — `tests/components/ui-tile.test.tsx` "tile element": render `<Tile label="L" href="/x"/>` -> `container.querySelector('a[href="/x"]')` exists; `<Tile label="L" onClick={fn}/>` -> a `button` exists, click calls fn once; `<Tile label="L"/>` -> root is `div`, no `a`, no `button`. Label text "L" visible in all three. PASS if all assertions hold.

E3. Tile value/caption/meter — "tile content": `<Tile label="Sum insured" value="5 L" caption="Per year" meter={40}/>` shows texts "Sum insured", "5 L", "Per year"; a meter element exists with fill width 40% (style width or aria-valuenow=40). PASS if all found.

E4. SoonTile — "soon tile": `<SoonTile label="Claims" caption="x"/>`; root (getByTitle("Coming soon")) has `aria-disabled="true"`, `tabIndex` attribute `0`, title `Coming soon`; text "Coming soon" present; label "Claims" present; no serif value element (no `[data-value]`/value node rendered; text content has only label, caption, "Coming soon"). PASS if all hold.

E5. SoonButton — "soon button": `<SoonButton onClick={fn}>Add</SoonButton>` (extra handler passed) renders element with `aria-disabled="true"`, title `Coming soon`, text "Add" and "Soon"; `userEvent.click` -> `fn` not called (0 calls). PASS if so.

E6. MissingTile — "missing tile": `<MissingTile label="Room rent"/>` shows "Room rent" and "Not in your policy". PASS if both found.

E7. RetryTile — "retry tile": `<RetryTile label="Cover" onRetry={fn}/>` shows "Couldn't load"; click button named "Retry" -> fn called once. PASS if so.

E8. BarList — "bar list": rows `[{label:"A",pct:80,value:"₹8L"},{label:"B",pct:20,value:"₹2L"}]` -> exactly 2 rows (`[data-testid="bar-row"]` or `role=listitem`), each with its label text and value text ("₹8L","₹2L"). Fill width 80% / 20%. Empty rows `[]` renders without throwing. PASS if all hold.

E9. AskCard — "ask card": `prompts={["a","b","c"]}` -> exactly 2 links rendered; hrefs equal `/chat?q=a` and `/chat?q=b`; no "c". Prompt with space `"what is x"` -> href `/chat?q=what%20is%20x` or `+`-encoded (decodes to the prompt). With `href="/ask"` base -> `/ask?q=a`. PASS if all hold.

E10. CountUp — "count up": fake timers (`vi.useFakeTimers`, mock `requestAnimationFrame`/`performance.now`), `<CountUp to={1200} format={n=>`₹${Math.round(n)}`} ms={100}/>`, advance 200 ms -> text content is exactly `₹1200`. PASS if so. Also: `format` called with final value 1200.

E11. Reveal + BentoGrid smoke — "reveal grid": `<BentoGrid cols={2}><Reveal><div>kid</div></Reveal></BentoGrid>` renders "kid"; `split` prop renders without error and the grid root's style/class carries the split variant (class contains `split` or inline `1.3fr 1fr`). PASS if kid found, no throw.

E12. Tokens diff — cmd: `git diff origin/main -- src/styles/tokens.css | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)'` — PASS if output is exactly additions defining `--bento-gap` and `--tile-pad` (no `-` lines, no other `+` lines).

E13. No hex in tiles css — cmd: `grep -cE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}\b' src/components/ui/tiles.module.css` — expect: `0` — PASS if count is 0 (file must exist).

E14. Dev gallery + full gate — (a) cmd: `grep -n 'notFound' src/app/dev/ui/page.tsx && grep -n 'NODE_ENV' src/app/dev/ui/page.tsx` — PASS if both match; and vitest `tests/components/ui-dev-page.test.tsx` "dev page 404 in prod": `vi.stubEnv('NODE_ENV','production')`, mock `next/navigation` notFound to throw, call page default export -> notFound called; with `development` it renders and notFound not called. (b) cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if exit 0.
